content: JWT refresh race condition: when multiple parallel requests hit a 401 simultaneously, each independently triggers a refresh, causing a 'refresh stampede' (5-10 duplicate refresh calls), which can invalidate rotating refresh tokens and cause random logouts / 401 loops. Fix: single-flight pattern - one shared in-flight refresh Promise; all concurrent 401s await the same promise instead of calling refresh again; queue failed requests and replay them once the new token lands. Must be implemented at the HTTP client interceptor level so it applies to every call automatically. Nearly invisible in dev (sequential requests), brutal in prod (dashboards firing many endpoints at once).
